outline: 使學生建立邏輯量化思考，並了解管理科學解決問題之方法及應用，且有能力利用電腦工具協助分析經營管理問題，達成最佳化決策。
schedule:
Week 1 Introduction
Week 2-3: Linear programming
Week 4-5: Solving linear programming problem: The simplex method
Week 6-8: The theory of the simplex method
Week 9: 	Mid-term test
Week 10-14:  Duality theory and sensitivity analysis
Week 15: Other Algorithms for linear programming
Week 16-17: The transportation and assignment problem
Week 8: Final Exam
assessment:
Homeworks and Assignments: 30%
Midterm Exam: 35%
Final Exam: 35%
*Class Participation: extra 5%
